'''Mucdermon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], where he developed a method of disabling and reprogramming the [[RCH-01 shielded cannon]]s that the [[Balmorran resistance]] had established in the [[Gorinth Canyon]].<ref name="TOR" />
